name: sidebar-overlay-starter
description: Browser extension starter: a React sidebar overlay that slides in from the right of any page.

scripts.dev: npm run clean && concurrently -k -n ext,content -c blue,magenta "vite build --watch" "vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch"
scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
